title: Hardcore compatability for Epic Death Screen
description: Enable  in hardcore mode for Neoforge version
body:
# Epic Death Screen: Hardcore Patch

**Technical extension for NeoForge 1.21.1 that enables cinematic death animations in Hardcore mode.**

## About

This is a technical patch for the original [**Epic Death Screen**](https://modrinth.com/mod/epic-death-screen) mod by [**Litewer**](https://modrinth.com/user/Litewer). This patch enables the cinematic death screen in **Hardcore mode**, which is not supported in the original version.

## Requirements
* **NeoForge 1.21.1**
* **Original Mod:** [Epic Death Screen](https://modrinth.com/mod/epic-death-screen) (Must be installed alongside this patch)

## Features
- **Hardcore Support:** Shows the epic death screen after death in hardcore mode.
- **Spectator Transition:** Correctly respawns the player in spectator mode after the animation ends.
